propositions: Review gates read effective criteria through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored and project DET criteria to disappear unpredictably
Separate reads of ambient policy can describe different repository states when consulted by code-review and detector registries

A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot bound to repository and operation inputs must compile effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, and routing metadata with deterministic digest before any selection or model call

Code-review project LLM criteria must require non-empty applies_to globs with ["**"] spelling for repository-wide unconditional selection, while shared validator and plan-review criteria remain unchanged

An applies_to glob matching no changed paths produces a typed non-applicable reason without criterion execution, and empty changed_files with ["**"] criterion must remain unconditionally selected to preserve prior ungated behavior
